paragraphs: The ML350 CDI uses the OM642 — a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine. It was fitted to the W164-generation M-Class from 2005 to 2011. The OM642 is a well-known diesel engine in the Mercedes range, used across multiple models of that era. The ML350 CDI is one of the most popular diesel variants of the M-Class, offering a balance of performance and fuel economy.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every ML350 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the ML350 CDI from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the ML350 CDI uses a single engine code — the OM642 — across its entire production run, compatibility is straightforward. However, there can be minor variations depending on the exact model year and specification. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic M-Class quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
